hero.kicker: Ship with the fastest growing Caribbean shipping firm in NYC!
hero.title: Make Ship Happen!
hero.lede: For all your freight shipping services to St. Lucia and all islands of the Caribbean. Barrels, boxes, packages, cars, containers & all personal effects.

faq.q: How long does shipping to the Caribbean take?
faq.a: Most islands see arrival in 10–14 days on the water, plus 1–2 days for customs clearance at the destination port. Vessels depart Brooklyn every Thursday — check the schedule above for exact cut-off and arrival dates.

faq.q: What can I pack in a barrel?
faq.a: Non-perishable food, clothing, household goods, toiletries, small electronics. No aerosols, flammables, or restricted items — call us if you're unsure and we'll tell you straight.

faq.q: Which islands do you ship to?
faq.a: Direct service to St. Lucia (Port Castries and Vieux-Fort), and through our West-Indies Shipping partner network we reach islands across the Caribbean — Jamaica, Trinidad & Tobago, Barbados, Grenada, St. Vincent, Dominica and more. Call for rates beyond St. Lucia.

faq.q: Do you pick up from my home?
faq.a: Yes — pickup is FREE anywhere in Brooklyn and just $20 in the other boroughs. Add it when you build your quote or call (718) 483-8006 to schedule.

faq.q: Can you ship vehicles, containers, or commercial cargo?
faq.a: Yes — cars, trucks, full 20ft and 40ft containers, and regular commercial consignments for businesses across the islands, with paperwork handled end to end. Call us for a quote.

faq.q: What is customs clearance like on the islands?
faq.a: Duties and clearance rules differ island to island. Our port agents guide your consignee through the process, and personal-effects shipments like barrels typically clear in 1–2 days.
Cash, card, or Zelle at drop-off or pickup — or pay online: lock in a quote with a card deposit, or pay your EB/L number in full. Your estimate is confirmed when we weigh and manifest your cargo.
